WITH fee_rows AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge AS side,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
), group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS group_avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM fee_rows
  GROUP BY orderslink, side
), side_averages AS (
  SELECT
    side,
    AVG(group_avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM group_averages
  GROUP BY side
)
SELECT
  g.orderslink,
  g.side,
  g.group_avg_net_fee_rate,
  g.record_count,
  g.group_avg_net_fee_rate - s.side_avg_net_fee_rate AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
JOIN side_averages AS s
  ON g.side = s.side
WHERE g.group_avg_net_fee_rate > s.side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The record count counts qualifying fee records, including rows whose net fee rate is NULL; AVG ignores NULL net fee rates, as requested.
